evals.name: iphone-settings-standalone
evals.prompt: Devo rifare la schermata impostazioni della mia app iPhone (SwiftUI, iOS 26+) per seguire le partite di calcio: notifiche per squadra preferita (gol, inizio partita, risultato finale), lingua, tema chiaro/scuro, gestione account e abbonamento premium. Prima di toccare il codice fammi vedere qualche proposta, deve sembrare un'app Apple.
evals.expected_output: A scratch directory with 2-4 SwiftUI variants built from stock components, real simulator captures (light and dark) per variant, a tabbed decision page with tradeoffs and a 'Try it' command per variant, and a message that ends by asking the user to pick. No production code.

evals.name: mac-window-three-structures
evals.prompt: I'm building a Mac app to manage my podcast recordings: a library of episodes (title, show, duration, recording date, status: draft/edited/published), a detail view with the waveform and chapter markers, and export presets. How should the main window look? Show me a few options before I write any of it.
evals.expected_output: 2-4 Mac variants that differ in window structure (two columns, three columns, inspector), captured as real windows with a selected row, plausible episode data, menus and shortcuts named in the notes, and a request for feedback.

evals.name: android-missing-toolchain
evals.prompt: app android in compose per prenotare campi da padel, mi serve la schermata di ricerca: data, fascia oraria, circolo, tipo di campo (indoor/outdoor), prezzo. come la faresti? voglio vedere delle alternative
evals.expected_output: On a machine without the Android SDK: says so before designing and offers to set the toolchain up or fall back to design-proposal with an HTML approximation labelled as such. With the SDK: Compose Material 3 variants captured from the emulator.
